import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    # retain one blank cell between each colored divider
    rows = [None]
    for r in hr:
        rows.extend([r, None])
    cols = [None]
    for c in vc:
        cols.extend([c, None])
    out = [[0 for _ in cols] for _ in rows]
    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
        if r is not None:
            for j in range(len(cols)):
                out[i][j] = grid[r][cols[j]] if cols[j] is not None else grid[r][0]
    for j, c in enumerate(cols):
        if c is not None:
            for i in range(len(rows)):
                out[i][j] = grid[rows[i]][c] if rows[i] is not None else grid[0][c]
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
